llm.summary: This Gmail skill is a disclosed wrapper around the gws Gmail CLI; it can access and change email, but the artifact does not show hidden or deceptive behavior.

dimensions.detail: Authenticated Gmail access is sensitive but proportionate to a Gmail management skill; the artifact does not request unrelated local filesystem, credential, or system access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable code or install script is bundled; metadata requires an existing gws binary, and the artifact discloses a gws generate-skills step if the shared skill is missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is concise command guidance and tells the agent to inspect schemas before API calls; it also depends on an out-of-scope shared gws skill for auth, global flags, and security rules, which was not present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or privilege escalation is present; Gmail watch can create mailbox push-notification state, but it is listed as a Gmail API resource rather than hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to send, read, and manage Gmail, and the listed commands/resources match that purpose, including sensitive capabilities such as messages, settings, drafts, labels, and watch/stop.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let the gws CLI operate on your Gmail account. Review the Google account/scopes used by gws and be careful with send, settings, and watch operations because they can affect real email behavior.
